# Warlock Notifications

> Package: `@warlock.js/notifications`

> Multi-channel notifications for Warlock.js — define once, fire anywhere; mail / in-app database / pluggable custom channels with preferences, rate limits, and idempotency.

## Skills

- [configure-notifications](@warlock.js/notifications/configure-notifications/SKILL.md): Configure notifications in @warlock.js/notifications; use when you need to configure notifications.
- [define-channel](@warlock.js/notifications/define-channel/SKILL.md): defineChannel — custom channels in @warlock.js/notifications; use when you need to define channel.
- [define-notification](@warlock.js/notifications/define-notification/SKILL.md): defineNotification — reusable multi-channel notification in @warlock.js/notifications; use when you need to define notification.
- [notifications-basics](@warlock.js/notifications/notifications-basics/SKILL.md): Start here for @warlock.js/notifications channels, notification definitions, delivery, and application setup.
- [observe-notifications](@warlock.js/notifications/observe-notifications/SKILL.md): Observe notifications in @warlock.js/notifications; use when you need to observe notifications.
- [queue-notifications](@warlock.js/notifications/queue-notifications/SKILL.md): Queue notifications (async) in @warlock.js/notifications; use when you need to queue notifications.
- [send-ad-hoc](@warlock.js/notifications/send-ad-hoc/SKILL.md): notify.<channel> — ad-hoc, per-channel sends in @warlock.js/notifications; use when you need to send ad hoc.
- [use-in-app](@warlock.js/notifications/use-in-app/SKILL.md): inApp — in-app notification read API in @warlock.js/notifications; use when you need to use in app.
- [write-notification-migration](@warlock.js/notifications/write-notification-migration/SKILL.md): Write the notifications migration in @warlock.js/notifications; use when you need to write notification migration.
